# Do NOT edit by hand. Regenerate after changing requirements.txt:
#   pip download -r requirements.txt --dest <dir> --only-binary :all: \
#       --python-version 3.10 --implementation cp --abi cp310 --platform manylinux_2_17_x86_64 --platform manylinux2014_x86_64
#   (repeat for --python-version 3.12 --abi cp312 into a second dir), then sha256 every wheel
#   and merge into this file: one `name==version --hash=sha256:...` block per package,
#   adding both dirs' hashes to the same block unless the resolved version itself differs
#   across python versions (see websockets below), in which case split by python_version marker.
